root.label: Two-phase lookup
root.note: Non-dependent names resolve at the definition; dependent names resolve at instantiation.

children.label: What is dependent
children.note: Dependency is defined structurally from the template parameters.

children.label: Dependent types
children.note: T, T*, vector<T>, T::type and decltype of a type-dependent expression.

children.label: Dependent expressions
children.note: Type-dependent like t + 1, or value-dependent like sizeof(T) or N.

children.label: Dependent calls
children.note: An unqualified call is dependent when any argument is type-dependent.

children.label: Phase one
children.note: Checked when the template definition is parsed.

children.label: Bound at definition
children.note: Non-dependent names bind to what is visible there; later overloads are ignored.

children.label: Early errors
children.note: An undeclared non-dependent function call is rejected even if never instantiated.

children.label: Never valid: IFNDR
children.note: No valid specialization possible: ill-formed NDR; Clang diagnoses more than GCC.

children.label: Phase two
children.note: Dependent names are resolved for each specialization.

children.label: Ordinary lookup
children.note: For dependent calls, only from the template definition context.

children.label: ADL both contexts
children.note: Argument-dependent lookup also searches from the point of instantiation.

children.label: Fundamental types
children.note: int has no associated namespaces, so later declarations are never found.

children.label: Disambiguators
children.note: Tell the parser what a dependent qualified name is.

children.label: typename
children.note: Without it, T::type is assumed to be a value; T::type * p is multiplication.

children.label: template keyword
children.note: Needed in h.template get<3>() when h is dependent and < follows.

children.label: C++20 P0634
children.note: typename optional in type-only contexts such as aliases, members and returns.

children.label: Still required
children.note: In function bodies and unqualified namespace-scope function parameters.

children.label: Class templates
children.note: Which members are known while the class is being defined.

children.label: Current instantiation
children.note: Node, Node<T> and this name it; its members are looked up in phase one.

children.label: Dependent bases
children.note: Unknown specializations; unqualified lookup never searches them.

children.label: this-> fix
children.note: this->, Base<T>:: or a using-declaration defers the name to phase two.

children.label: Silent global
children.note: An unqualified call may bind to a global function instead of the base member.
